description: This file defines a NotificationsService class for managing local notifications in a Flutter app. It handles initialization, permission requests, scheduling, and canceling reminders using the flutter_local_notifications plugin, including platform-specific configuration and timezone handling.

classes.name: NotificationsService
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods for initializing, requesting permissions, scheduling, and canceling local notifications related to task reminders.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes timezone data, sets up notification plugin with platform-specific settings, and registers notification channels on Android.

methods.name: requestPermissionsIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests notification permissions on iOS, macOS, and Android if supported.

methods.name: scheduleReminder
methods.description: Schedules local reminders for a given TaskItem, handling multiple reminders, timezone conversion, and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: cancelRemindersForTask
methods.description: Cancels all scheduled reminders associated with a specific task ID.

methods.name: _buildReminderBody
methods.description: Builds the notification body text based on task description and due date.

methods.name: _notificationIdFor
methods.description: Generates a deterministic notification ID based on task ID and index.

methods.name: _safeLocalTimeZoneName
methods.description: Returns the local timezone name; currently defaults to tz.local.name.
